title: Erasing the Last Buffered Cell
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and bit $b$, changing cell $|w|$ of the buffer tape storing $w$ followed by $b$ to blank gives exactly the buffer tape storing $w$.
replaced:
For every Boolean word $w$ and bit $b$, blanking cell $|w|$ of the buffer tape holding
$w$ followed by $b$ yields the buffer tape of $w$.
